title: FitSync: Workout Tracker
shortDescription: Log workouts, track progress and build a training routine that fits your day
fullDescription:
Bring your training and everyday progress together with FitSync.

WORKOUTS, REMEMBERED
Log sets, reps, weight, time and distance. See previous performance, use a rest timer, celebrate personal records and revisit your workout history. Save edits to an active workout on your phone and sync them when your connection returns.

A PLAN FOR YOUR WEEK
Explore exercises and published programs, build reusable routines, or create a starter plan from your goals, experience, equipment and available time. Planning suggestions follow training rules and your recorded activity.

PROGRESS BEYOND THE GYM
Track steps, water, nutrition, body measurements and recovery. Optionally connect Android Health Connect to import steps, sleep and body weight. Access is read-only and depends on your device, permissions and available health records. Extra steps you enter are stored separately. The optional walk counter records a walk while FitSync stays open; it is not an all-day background tracker.

OPTIONAL FITSYNC PRO
Pro adds adaptive training plans, deeper analytics, meal planning, private custom exercises and other extras. Available subscriptions and prices are shown in the app through Google Play. Manage or cancel renewal in Google Play; deleting your FitSync account does not cancel a subscription.

Google sign-in and an internet connection are required for account setup and cloud features. Some features require optional device permissions.

FitSync provides general fitness and wellness information. Meal plans, weight-management suggestions and other health features are not medical advice, diagnosis or treatment.

Delete your account from Settings in the app or use the account-deletion page linked in the store listing.
